## Problem And Change

Explain the user problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there
is one. For command output, show a short before/after example with invented data.

## Verification

Describe checks you ran and their results, or explain why a check was not relevant.
For documentation, verify changed commands and links.

## Contributor Checklist

- [ ] This change is focused and includes relevant documentation.
- [ ] Examples and fixtures use synthetic data and contain no private records or credentials.
- [ ] Behavior changes include appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] Any storage change adds a new migration and preserves existing records; historical migrations are untouched.

Mark items that apply; explain anything that does not. Draft pull requests and
questions about the implementation are welcome.
